findings.rule: 'while True' whose only exit is a leading 'if c: <tail>' is 'while not c' followed by <tail>; a load through a constant pointer stored at a constant address (mem[192] = 224) folds to mem[224] when no later store can reach address 192 (free-pointer-based stores are above the initial pointer).
